rewritten_query:
select cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count, count(*) as cnt
from (
  select ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_quantity
  from store_sales
  where exists (
    select 1
    from item
    where i_item_sk = ss_item_sk
      and i_category in ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
      and i_manager_id in (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
  )
) ss
join (
  select i_item_sk
  from item
  where i_category in ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
    and i_manager_id in (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
) i on ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
join (
  select ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk
  from web_sales
  where ws_wholesale_cost between 31 and 51
) ws on ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
join (
  select d_date_sk, d_date
  from date_dim
  where d_year = 2001
) d1 on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
join date_dim d2 on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)
join customer on ss.ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  and ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
join inventory on ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
  and inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  and inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
join warehouse on ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
join store on s_state = w_state
join customer_demographics on c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
join household_demographics on c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
join (
  select ca_address_sk
  from customer_address
  where ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
) ca on c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
where ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  and inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  and inv_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
  and ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
order by cnt

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH date_2001 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
sr_agg AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           sr.sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
           SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_2001 d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg AS (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return
    FROM sr_agg
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
),
ctr1_filtered AS (
    SELECT ctr_customer_sk,
           ctr_store_sk,
           ctr_reason_sk,
           ctr_total_return
    FROM sr_agg
    WHERE ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
      AND ctr_store_sk IN (
          SELECT s_store_sk
          FROM store
          WHERE s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
      )
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM ctr1_filtered ctr1
JOIN store_avg ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = store_avg.ctr_store_sk
 AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > store_avg.avg_total_return
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
 AND customer.c_birth_month = 5
 AND customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
JOIN customer_demographics ON customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
 AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
 AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
 AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M'
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

  join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and date_dim.d_year = 2001 and date_dim.d_moy between 1 and 4
  join item on ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk and item.i_category in ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports') and item.i_manager_id between 91 and 100
  where ss_sales_price / ss_list_price between 0.17 and 0.27
),

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
)
SELECT avg(ss.ss_quantity),
       avg(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),
       avg(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
       sum(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN date_filtered dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
) hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'W', 'S')
      AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '2 yr Degree')
) cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA', 'MT', 'OH', 'OR', 'GA', 'IL', 'TX')
) ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'U'
         AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
         AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
         AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
         AND cd.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
         AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
         AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'S'
         AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
         AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
         AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA')
         AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
         AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX')

WITH
ss_brand_class AS (
  SELECT iss.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iss.i_class_id AS class_id, iss.i_category_id AS category_id
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND iss.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
cs_brand_class AS (
  SELECT ics.i_brand_id AS brand_id, ics.i_class_id AS class_id, ics.i_category_id AS category_id
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ics.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
ws_brand_class AS (
  SELECT iws.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iws.i_class_id AS class_id, iws.i_category_id AS category_id
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item
  JOIN (
    SELECT brand_id, class_id, category_id FROM ss_brand_class
    INTERSECT
    SELECT brand_id, class_id, category_id FROM cs_brand_class
    INTERSECT
    SELECT brand_id, class_id, category_id FROM ws_brand_class
  ) x ON i_brand_id = x.brand_id AND i_class_id = x.class_id AND i_category_id = x.category_id
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
),
ss_qty_price AS (
  SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
cs_qty_price AS (
  SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
ws_qty_price AS (
  SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT sum(total_sales) / NULLIF(sum(sales_cnt), 0) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT sum(quantity * list_price) AS total_sales, count(quantity * list_price) AS sales_cnt FROM ss_qty_price
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sum(quantity * list_price), count(quantity * list_price) FROM cs_qty_price
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sum(quantity * list_price), count(quantity * list_price) FROM ws_qty_price
  ) b
),
ty_week_seq AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
),
ly_week_seq AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
),
ty_item_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales, count(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  JOIN ty_week_seq tw ON dd.d_week_seq = tw.d_week_seq
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY ss_item_sk
),
ly_item_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales, count(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  JOIN ly_week_seq lw ON dd.d_week_seq = lw.d_week_seq
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY ss_item_sk
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id,
         sum(tys.sales) AS sales, sum(tys.number_sales) AS number_sales
  FROM ty_item_sales tys
  JOIN item ON tys.ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN cross_items ci ON tys.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING sum(tys.sales) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id,
         sum(lys.sales) AS sales, sum(lys.number_sales) AS number_sales
  FROM ly_item_sales lys
  JOIN item ON lys.ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN cross_items ci ON lys.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING sum(lys.sales) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)

),
item_f as (
  select i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  from item
  where i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')

),
cross_items as (

       (select iss.i_brand_id brand_id, iss.i_class_id class_id, iss.i_category_id category_id
        from ss_3yr, item_f iss
        where ss_3yr.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
        intersect
        select ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
        from cs_3yr, item_f ics
        where cs_3yr.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
        intersect
        select iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
        from ws_3yr, item iws
        where ws_3yr.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk) x

avg_sales as (

        select SUM(cs_quantity*cs_list_price) s, COUNT(cs_quantity*cs_list_price) c from cs_3yr

ty_dates as (

),

rewritten_query:
WITH target_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '1999-02-11')
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT item.i_item_id AS item_id, c.c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN target_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = target_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
    JOIN customer AS c ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    WHERE store_sales.ss_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
    GROUP BY item.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT item.i_item_id AS item_id, c.c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(catalog_sales.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN target_dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = target_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
    JOIN customer AS c ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    WHERE catalog_sales.cs_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
    GROUP BY item.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
    SELECT item.i_item_id AS item_id, c.c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(web_sales.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN target_dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = target_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
    JOIN customer AS c ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    WHERE web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
    GROUP BY item.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
)
SELECT ss_items.item_id, ss_items.birth_year
       , ss_item_rev
       , ss_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 ss_dev
       , cs_item_rev
       , cs_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 cs_dev
       , ws_item_rev
       , ws_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 ws_dev
       , (ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3 average
FROM ss_items, cs_items, ws_items
WHERE ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id
  AND ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id
  AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
  AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100

select cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, count(*) cnt3
from (select *
      from customer c
      where exists (select 1
                    from store_sales
                    where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk

                      from web_sales
                      where c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
                      and ws_sold_date_sk in (select d_date_sk
                                              from date_dim
                                              where d_year = 2002
                                              and d_moy between 5 and 7)
                      and ws_list_price between 132 and 221)
      and not exists (select 1
                      from catalog_sales
                      where c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk
                      and cs_sold_date_sk in (select d_date_sk
                                              from date_dim
                                              where d_year = 2002
                                              and d_moy between 5 and 7)
                      and cs_list_price between 132 and 221)) c,
     customer_address ca,
     customer_demographics
where c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
and ca_state in ('MD','MO','OK')
and cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
and cd_marital_status in ('W', 'U')
and cd_education_status in ('Primary')
group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating

WITH target_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date IN ('1998-03-05','1998-06-15','1998-09-12','1998-10-31')
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dd.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN target_months tm ON dd.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
),
sr_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id item_id, SUM(a.sr_item_qty) sr_item_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN target_dates td ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
            AND sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 141 AND 170
            AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
        GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
    ) a
    JOIN item i ON a.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
cr_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id item_id, SUM(a.cr_item_qty) cr_item_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT cr.cr_item_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN target_dates td ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
            AND cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 141 AND 170
            AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
        GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
    ) a
    JOIN item i ON a.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
wr_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id item_id, SUM(a.wr_item_qty) wr_item_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN target_dates td ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
            AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 141 AND 170
            AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
        GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
    ) a
    JOIN item i ON a.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT sr_items.item_id
      ,sr_item_qty
      ,sr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 sr_dev
      ,cr_item_qty
      ,cr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 cr_dev
      ,wr_item_qty
      ,wr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 wr_dev
      ,(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 average
FROM sr_items, cr_items, wr_items
WHERE sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id
  AND sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id
ORDER BY sr_items.item_id
        ,sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100;

with dd as (
  select d_date_sk
  from date_dim
  where d_year = 2000
),
ca_f as (
  select ca_address_sk, ca_state
  from customer_address
  where ca_country = 'United States'
)
select substring(r.r_reason_desc,1,20), avg(ws.ws_quantity), avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr.wr_fee)
from web_sales ws
join web_returns wr
  on ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
 and ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
join dd
  on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
join customer_demographics cd1
  on cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
join customer_demographics cd2
  on cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
join ca_f
  on ca_f.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
join reason r
  on r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
where (
    (
      cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
      and cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
      and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D'
      and cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
      and cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
      and cd2.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
      and ws.ws_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00
    )
    or
    (
      cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
      and cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
      and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'S'
      and cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
      and cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
      and cd2.cd_education_status = 'College'
      and ws.ws_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00

      and cd2.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
      and ws.ws_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00
    )
  )
  and (
    (
      ca_f.ca_state in ('AR', 'FL', 'WI')
      and ws.ws_net_profit between 100 and 200
    )
    or
    (
      ca_f.ca_state in ('MO', 'NC', 'PA')

    )
    or
    (
      ca_f.ca_state in ('AR', 'OK', 'TX')
      and ws.ws_net_profit between 50 and 250
    )
  )
group by r.r_reason_desc
order by substring(r.r_reason_desc,1,20), avg(ws.ws_quantity), avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr.wr_fee)

WITH dd AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND date '2001-04-30'
),
wsf AS (
  SELECT w.ws_item_sk, w.ws_ext_discount_amt, w.ws_sales_price, w.ws_list_price
  FROM web_sales w
  JOIN dd ON w.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  WHERE w.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77
),
avg_amt AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS a
  FROM wsf
  WHERE ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.32
  GROUP BY ws_item_sk
)

FROM wsf
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = wsf.ws_item_sk
JOIN avg_amt ON avg_amt.ws_item_sk = wsf.ws_item_sk
WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 749 AND 948 OR i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))
  AND wsf.ws_ext_discount_amt > avg_amt.a
ORDER BY SUM(wsf.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;
